page_title: BOL 1-2 VER | Bologna v Verona 08/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Giuseppe Mucera has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Al Musrati (Verona) comes onto the pitch so that Gift Orban can be given a rest.
90+3' What a big chance! Santiago Castro (Bologna) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and misses the net well wide of the right post.
90+1' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Verona was in an offside position.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
88' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Verona due to a foul in the build-up play.
87' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Verona players aren’t happy.
86' GOAL! Amin Sarr (Verona) runs onto a pass from Gift Orban after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 1:3.
84' It will be a substitution. Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) is ready to enter the pitch as Martin Vitik walks off.
83' Tomas Suslov (Verona) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
82' Here is a change. Kieron Bowie is going off and Paolo Sammarco gives the last tactical orders to Amin Sarr (Verona).
82' Daniel Oyegoke is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Nicolas Valentini (Verona).
82' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
80' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
79' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
78' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post.
77' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Charalampos Lykogiannis replaces Nadir Zortea (Bologna).
77' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Jonathan Rowe will be replaced by Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna).
76' Gift Orban (Verona) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
74' That will be all from Abdou Harroui who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Tomas Suslov (Verona).
73' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
72' The referee blows his whistle as Joao Mario (Bologna) was too aggressive in his challenge.
70' Giuseppe Mucera blows his whistle as Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
69' Total attempts – 11:11.
67' Verona are ruled offside.
66' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Lewis Ferguson and he is replaced by Simon Sohm (Bologna).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Riccardo Orsolini trots off the pitch and is replaced by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna).
64' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
61' Bologna keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
59' The possession of the ball – 64:36.
57' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Gift Orban laid the ball off to Kieron Bowie (Verona), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
55' Kieron Bowie (Verona) makes a rough challenge and Giuseppe Mucera blows his whistle for a foul.
53' 1 - 1 Goal! Martin Frese (Verona) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom right corner. It's 1:1.
51' Some patient build-up play from Bologna as they look to unlock the defence.
49' 1 - 0 Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
48' A cross into the box from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is cleared.
47' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) got hold of the ball and swiftly shot from the edge of the box. His fine strike, however, only found the right post.
47' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' The whistle blows and Giuseppe Mucera starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Bologna will take a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Kieron Bowie (Verona) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
42' Abdou Harroui (Verona) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
40' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) has tested the patience of referee Giuseppe Mucera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
39' The referee awards a corner and Nikola Moro (Bologna) goes over to take it.
38' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
35' The total number of attempts is 3:7.
33' It looks like Martin Frese (Verona) saw red with that tackle. Giuseppe Mucera won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
31' Verona take a short corner kick.
30' A cross into the box picks out Kieron Bowie (Verona), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the left post.
29' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Gift Orban (Verona) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.

27' A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates.
26' Martin Vitik (Bologna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
25' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
23' A player from Verona commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
20' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) sends a long cross over to Riccardo Orsolini, but Lorenzo Montipo comes forward to gather the ball.
18' Bologna are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
16' Giuseppe Mucera shows a yellow card to Kieron Bowie (Verona) for his blatant foul.
15' Santiago Castro (Bologna) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.

13' Victor Nelsson (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Giuseppe Mucera with no other option than to blow for a foul.
11' Santiago Castro (Bologna) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
10' Some great controlled play and passing from Bologna. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) is able to continue to play.
6' The game is interrupted now, Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
5' Nikola Moro (Bologna) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
3' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Bologna will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Giuseppe Mucera.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
